actions.mechanism: Monotonic deadlines prevent clock changes or repeated reads from extending freshness.
actions.implementation: Set expiry to fetch-start time plus 300 seconds. Purge at expiry and before reads; discard responses arriving after their deadline.
actions.check: With a fake clock, verify a record is unavailable at exactly 300 seconds, including after repeated reads and wall-clock changes.
actions.risk: Conservative timing shortens useful lifetime for slow fetches.

actions.mechanism: Slot reservations include cached records and incoming records, preventing concurrent fetches from exceeding capacity.
actions.implementation: Reserve a slot before fetching. Remove expired entries first, then least-recently-used entries. If every slot is reserved, reject new fetches explicitly.
actions.check: Run concurrent requests for 150 distinct records; assert occupied plus reserved slots never exceeds 100 and eviction order matches policy.
actions.risk: Counting incoming records reduces available cache capacity.

actions.action: Define timeout responses and outage eviction
actions.mechanism: Bounded source waits produce explicit failures without treating expired records as usable cache hits.
actions.implementation: Set a two-second source timeout. Return 504 with source_timeout; return 503 for unavailable sources. Retain unexpired entries only until their original expiry.
actions.check: Simulate a hanging source: fresh hits succeed, misses return 504, and expired entries are removed rather than served.
actions.risk: Two seconds is an initial policy requiring operational review.

actions.action: Coalesce simultaneous requests for one record
actions.mechanism: One bounded fetch per key avoids duplicate source calls and competing cache writes.
actions.implementation: Maintain a bounded in-flight key map. Share fetch results among waiters; clear entries on completion. Reject late writes using fetch-generation tokens.
actions.check: Issue 50 simultaneous misses for one key; observe one source call. Deliver a timed-out result late and verify no insertion.
actions.risk: Waiter counts also need limits to bound metadata.

actions.action: Stop repeatedly calling a failing source
actions.mechanism: A circuit breaker temporarily rejects misses while allowing still-valid cache hits.
actions.implementation: After three consecutive source failures, open the circuit for 30 seconds. Return 503 with Retry-After; then allow one probe. Never modify cache deadlines.
actions.check: During an induced outage, verify no source calls occur while open, only one recovery probe runs, and expiry continues normally.
actions.risk: Recovery can remain undetected until the next probe.

actions.action: Restrict ingestion to verified public fields
actions.mechanism: An explicit source and schema allowlist prevents private payloads from entering the cache.
actions.implementation: Use only approved public endpoints without user credentials. Disable redirects and raw-body logging. Stream allowed fields; reject unknown schemas and oversized responses.
actions.check: Inject forbidden fields, redirects, and oversized bodies; verify rejection without cache insertion, response disclosure, or payload logging.
actions.risk: Field filtering cannot establish whether a source is public.

actions.action: Refresh active records before their expiry
actions.mechanism: Early refresh can obtain a replacement before a slow source makes the existing record unavailable.
actions.implementation: For recently accessed entries, schedule refresh between 240 and 270 seconds. Reserve replacement capacity and coalesce requests. Failures never extend the old deadline.
actions.check: Delay refresh beyond the old expiry; verify the old record disappears on time and replacement admission respects the 100-record limit.
actions.risk: Refresh traffic may worsen source overload; honor the circuit breaker.

actions.action: Expose cache age and failure state
actions.mechanism: Explicit response metadata distinguishes valid cached records from source failures and downstream stale copies.
actions.implementation: Return fetched_at, expires_at, and cache status with successful records. Set Cache-Control: no-store on responses. Use stable machine-readable error codes without record bodies.
actions.check: Inspect hit, miss, timeout, and circuit-open responses; confirm accurate timestamps, distinct error codes, and no freshness label on failures.
actions.risk: Clients may ignore metadata; server-side expiry remains authoritative.
